task: Rim light -10 percent, true sun-side crescent fresnel, streak shell on cloudy only
open_questions: Owner must check the crescent by eye: thickness at the sun limb, horn taper, and that no ring remains on the far side.
handoff: rim_strength 0.225 -> 0.2025 (export and shader), tunable 0..3. Ring source found: the atmosphere shell and the glow shell weighted the whole limb with mix(1, 0.5+0.5*dot, sun_bias=0.5), so the far side kept half strength and a full ring showed. Both now use the body's crescent gate (smoothstep on dot(normal, sun), squared) with sun_bias default 1.0, and read fres_side (set from fresnel_side in planet_sphere.gd). The body edge uses the same squared gate and a power that drops from 1.8x to 0.8x of fres_power towards the sun limb, so it is thick at the sun limb and thin at the horns. Rim light (opposite the sun, one-sided) and the fresnel_only variant use the same single fres term, so no other ring. Streaks shell: visible only when planet_type == cloudy (const STREAKS_TYPE), hidden on every other type; the look roll no longer gates it; cloudy glow mask stays removed. Not checked by eye (no GPU window).
